description.zh: 资源归属账号的ID，资源归属账号是实际使用资源的账号；只支持传入1个账号
description.en: The ID of the account whose data you want to query. If you do not specify this parameter, the data of the current account and its linked accounts is queried. To query the data of a linked account, specify the ID of the linked account. You can specify only one account ID.

description.zh: 格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss；查询逻辑为不包括该时间；为空表示截止到当前时间，查询对应的时间为结束时间
description.en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. The specified time is excluded from the time range. If you do not specify this parameter, this parameter is set to the current time.

description.zh: MONTH：月维度； DAY：天维度； HOUR：小时维度
description.en: The time granularity at which the data is queried. Valid values: MONTH, DAY, and HOUR.

description.zh: 资源包类型，枚举值包括RI/SCU；RI：预留实例； SCU：存储容量单位包
description.en: The type of the resource plan. Valid values: RI and SCU.

description.zh: 格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss； 查询逻辑为包括该时间，查询对应的时间为开始时间
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. The specified time is included in the time range.
